## Mechanic[]

The damage that you deal are increase the sum of all compatible "Increased Damage".

As example, with a skill "fire, spell", with 30% Increased Spell Damage, 40% Increased Fire Damage, and 50% Increased Cold Damage :

The damage will be increase by 30% + 40%, so the "Increased Damage" will multiply by 1.7 the damage.
